On days you want more greenery than water, Elephant Mountain’s gentler trails give you golden-hour panoramas without the full hike.
(c) If you’re looking to unwind after teaching, Da’an Park’s western lawn is ideal for bringing along a sketchpad and capturing the city’s trees and passerby in quick lines. On days you want more greenery than water, Elephant Mountain’s gentler trails make for quiet outdoor sketching sessions with a breeze.
(d) If you’re looking to unwind after work, the open lawns at Da’an Park offer a quiet place to relax and breathe deeply as the day winds down. On days you want more greenery than water, Elephant Mountain’s gentler trails give you panoramic city views without too much effort.
